Hi Damien / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the time on today's call — really appreciate the context on your ingestion timeline and the use case for live inference in your underwriting flow. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we stay unblocked on the commercial side: 

- Aisha (AE): finalize SOW and pricing; target signature: EOW if vendor enrollment completes this week.
- Marissa (Sales Ops): complete vendor enrollment and payment rails (W-9 + ACH) so we can provision billing and lift sandbox to production.
- Olive Procurement: confirm preferred ACH account details and provide completed W-9 (or confirm if procurement will upload to your vendor system).

Action items for Olive: please either attach the completed W-9 and ACH form in reply or confirm the vendor portal ID where we should expect the upload. If easier, we can send a secure DocuSign envelope for the ACH form.

I've attached the Redwood vendor onboarding checklist and a sample ACH form to this thread for reference.

Happy to jump on a 10-min call to walk procurement through the portal.
